import numpy as np
exec(open('lsbuild.py').read())
def r2(a,b): return 1-((a-b)**2).sum()/((b-b.mean(0))**2).sum()
def LN(x,g,b): mu=x.mean(1,keepdims=True); v=x.var(1,keepdims=True); return (x-mu)/np.sqrt(v+1e-5)*g+b
pre='roberta.encoder.layer.5.'
g2=base(pre+'output.LayerNorm.weight').astype(np.float64); be2=base(pre+'output.LayerNorm.bias').astype(np.float64)
ae=np.load('a5e_1536.npy').astype(np.float64)
ab,W1,b1,U,b2=layer_data(5,base)
Gb=gelu(ab@W1.T+b1); Ge=gelu(ae@W1.T+b1)
xb=ab+Gb@U.T+b2; hb=LN(xb,g2,be2)
folds=np.load('folds.npy'); nf=folds.max()+1
def fit_eval(m, lam, wb, we, evalset='e'):
    he=np.zeros_like(hb); hbb=np.zeros_like(hb)
    for f in range(nf):
        tr=folds!=f; te=~tr
        X=np.vstack([Gb[tr],Ge[tr]]); T=np.vstack([xb[tr]-ab[tr], xb[tr]-ae[tr]])
        w=np.concatenate([np.full(tr.sum(),wb),np.full(tr.sum(),we)]); keepw=w>0
        X=X[keepw]; T=T[keepw]; w=w[keepw]; sw=np.sqrt(w)[:,None]
        mu=(w[:,None]*X).sum(0)/w.sum(); tm=(w[:,None]*T).sum(0)/w.sum()
        Xc=(X-mu)*sw
        sc=(U**2).sum(0)*(Xc**2).sum(0)
        keep=np.sort(np.argsort(-sc)[:m])
        Xk=Xc[:,keep]; R=(T-tm)*sw-Xk@U[:,keep].T
        D=np.linalg.solve(Xk.T@Xk+lam*np.eye(m),Xk.T@R).T
        Un=U[:,keep]+D
        he[te]=LN(ae[te]+(Ge[te][:,keep]-mu[keep])@Un.T+tm,g2,be2)
        hbb[te]=LN(ab[te]+(Gb[te][:,keep]-mu[keep])@Un.T+tm,g2,be2)
    return round(r2(he,hb),4), round(r2(hbb,hb),4)
for wb,we in [(1,0),(0,1),(1,1),(0.5,1)]:
    for lam in (10,30,100):
        print(wb,we,lam, fit_eval(1536,lam,wb,we))
